production_gate_survival.source_support: Returned picks and aggregate scan-funnel drops are session-level, so survival rates are computed by session-backed dimensions such as playbook and month. Symbol/drop-key/gate rows report drop share, not returned-pick survival, because returned picks are not attributed to rejected symbols.

proof_boundary: This decomposition is read-only diagnostic evidence about scheduled Phase 2 drop reasons.
